messages:
Maria V.: heads up — overnight smoke run against canary (fused-attn v3, kernel-selector=auto) shows p99 up ~18% from baseline. spotted at ~02:10 UTC in nightly run.
Alex C.: noted. which benchmark mix? long seqs or short chatty traffic?
Maria V.: mostly long-seq decoder workloads (seq=1024), batch=1/2 mix. not significant throughput loss, just tail latency.
Jason R.: can you paste the raw guardrail logs? any OOMs or GC spikes?
Maria V.: no OOMs. attaching excerpt: 
```
[02:09:57] request_id=az12 kernel=fused_attn_v3 latency=12.3ms
[02:10:01] request_id=az13 kernel=fallback_attn latency=9.8ms
[02:10:02] request_id=az14 kernel=fused_attn_v3 latency=54.1ms <-- tail spike
```
Alex C.: interesting — looks like occasional stalls in fused path. could be lock contention or kernel choice oscillation. did selector switch kernels mid-request?
Maria V.: not mid-request; logs show kernel selected per-call but some invocation paths recompile kernels when seq shape changes.
Sam (devex): can we repro locally with harness? suggest: 
1) run smoketest with deterministic seq shapes (repeat same seq 1000x)
2) enable perf counters: `RUNTIME_PERF=1`
3) run with `--kernel-debug=trace`

benchbot: opened bench job #b-4872: nightly/canary/fused-attn-v3 -> attached profiling.
SRE Oncall: pinging infra — any node-level anomalies in that time window?
Alex C.: infra looks clean. GPU util steady, no PCIe errors.
Jason R.: hypotheses: (A) new fused kernel has a rare codepath that falls back to slower alg on certain seq lengths; (B) allocator fragmentation causing occasional memcopy path; (C) selector heuristic flips and causes microflushing.
Maria V.: actionable triage proposal: 
- short-term: pin canary to fused-attn v2 for 24h to avoid user impact.
- medium: run deterministic microbench (100k samples) across seq lengths 256/512/768/1024 on same hw and compare p99 distribution per-kernel.
- long-term: add a unit/regression test that stores p99 baseline for each kernel+seq shape and blocks merges if deviation >10%.

Sam (devex): for the regression test, suggest using the existing `bench-harness` with `--ci-mode` to avoid flakiness, and store artifacts in S3. we can wire a lightweight alert if p99 > baseline + 12%.
benchbot: scheduled microbench run -> job b-4873. expected finish in ~45m.
Alex C.: if microbench reproduces, we should bisect changes between v2 and v3. do we have a clean diff that isolates fusion loops?
Jason R.: yes — I'll prepare a bisect patchset and start a binary bisect on canary images. will also add kernel-level logging to catch any slow path triggers.
Maria V.: quick repro command for the team: 
```bash
./bench-harness --model gptx-mini --seq-len 1024 --batch 1 --iters 5000 --kernel fused_attn_v3 --perf=1 > /tmp/fusedv3.log
```
please run this on a canary node (tag: canary-gpu-3) and paste snippets if you see p99 > 40ms.
SRE Oncall: if we pin back to v2, what's deployment plan? roll forward release with pinned kernel image or toggle selector config?
Alex C.: easiest is feature-flag kernel-selector=prefer:v2 at routing layer, push to canary, then prod after 24h.
Sam (devex): I'll draft the PR for the CI regression and an ops playbook snippet (how to pin kernels, run microbench, and file perf artifacts).
Maria V.: ok team — priorities: 1) pin canary to v2 (Alex + SRE) 2) finish microbench and bisect (Jason + benchbot) 3) add regression CI + playbook (Sam).
Alex C.: assigning myself and SRE Oncall to the pin. starting rollout now. :thumbsup:
Jason R.: starting bisect and will share progress here.
benchbot: job b-4873 finished. summary: 1024-seq p50/p95/p99 for fused_attn_v3 = 9.2/18.7/53.9ms, fused_attn_v2 = 8.9/18.1/9.7ms. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/b-4873/
Maria V.: that's pretty decisive. good work.
Sam (devex): PR drafted: https://git.redwood/ops/bench-ci/pull/112 — includes script and alert rule.
Alex C.: rolled pin to v2 on canary. monitoring dashboards: no uplift so far.
Maria V.: leaving thread for updates; please paste any new logs or counter dumps here. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
